blocks.text: $AB$为圆的弦，$M$为弦$AB$的中点，$O$为坐标原点，若$AB,OM$的斜率存在，则$k_{AB}\cdot k_{OM}=-1$.
$AB$为椭圆的弦，$M$为弦$AB$的中点，$O$为坐标原点，若$AB,OM$的斜率存在，则$k_{AB}\cdot k_{OM}=-\frac{n^2}{m^2}$(焦点在$x$轴或$y$轴均成立).

设点$A(x_1,y_1),B(x_2,y_2)$，则$M\left(\frac{x_1+x_2}{2},\frac{y_1+y_2}{2}\right)$. 将$A,B$坐标代入椭圆方程得$\begin{cases}\frac{x_1^2}{m^2}+\frac{y_1^2}{n^2}=1,\\\frac{x_2^2}{m^2}+\frac{y_2^2}{n^2}=1,\end{cases}$两式作差得$\frac{x_1^2-x_2^2}{m^2}+\frac{y_1^2-y_2^2}{n^2}=0$，即$\frac{y_1-y_2}{x_1-x_2}\cdot\frac{\frac{y_1+y_2}{2}}{\frac{x_1+x_2}{2}}=-\frac{n^2}{m^2}$，从而$k_{AB}\cdot k_{OM}=-\frac{n^2}{m^2}$.
$AB$为双曲线的弦，$M$为弦$AB$的中点，$O$为坐标原点，若$AB,OM$的斜率存在，则$k_{AB}\cdot k_{OM}=\frac{n^2}{m^2}$(焦点在$x$轴或$y$轴均成立).

设点$A(x_1,y_1),B(x_2,y_2)$，则$M\left(\frac{x_1+x_2}{2},\frac{y_1+y_2}{2}\right)$. 将$A,B$坐标代入双曲线方程得$\begin{cases}\frac{x_1^2}{m^2}-\frac{y_1^2}{n^2}=\pm1,\\\frac{x_2^2}{m^2}-\frac{y_2^2}{n^2}=\pm1,\end{cases}$两式作差得$\frac{x_1^2-x_2^2}{m^2}-\frac{y_1^2-y_2^2}{n^2}=0$，即$\frac{y_1-y_2}{x_1-x_2}\cdot\frac{\frac{y_1+y_2}{2}}{\frac{x_1+x_2}{2}}=\frac{n^2}{m^2}$，从而$k_{AB}\cdot k_{OM}=\frac{n^2}{m^2}$.
$AB$为抛物线的弦，$M$为弦$AB$的中点，若直线$AB$的斜率存在，则$k_{AB}\cdot y_M=p$.

设点$A(x_1,y_1),B(x_2,y_2)$，则$M\left(\frac{x_1+x_2}{2},\frac{y_1+y_2}{2}\right)$. 将$A,B$坐标代入抛物线方程得$\begin{cases}y_1^2=2px_1,\\y_2^2=2px_2,\end{cases}$两式作差得$y_1^2-y_2^2=2p(x_1-x_2)$，即$\frac{y_1-y_2}{x_1-x_2}\cdot\frac{y_1+y_2}{2}=p$，从而$k_{AB}\cdot y_M=p$.
$AB$为抛物线的弦，$M$为弦$AB$的中点，则$x_M=p\cdot k_{AB}$.
